Sample journeys

Starting points,
not destinations.

These are real trips we've run — shown to give you a feel for rhythm and cost. Each is for one small party of two to six. Yours will look different. It should.

Journey № 0110 days

Mara Classic, our way

The Mara without the crowds. Private conservancies, night drives, and a rivercamp only reached by foot across a hippo bridge.

  1. Private conservancies
  2. The river camp
from $12,600per person, shared

Journey № 0214 days

Coast, craft, & bush

A full sweep — bush camps in Tsavo, dhow sailing in Lamu, a tailor in Malindi. Built for couples who want the land and the ocean.

  1. Tsavo
  2. Lamu
  3. Malindi
from $16,200per person, shared
Start from this →

Journey № 035 days

The short sabbatical

For guests with little time. A private conservancy in Laikipia, three guided walks, one hot-air balloon at dawn. Nothing more.

  1. Laikipia
from $6,800per person, shared
